description: Connected devices per room, placed by position by digital-twin from one Wi-Fi tick. Produced by digital-twin (Rust) on Kafka `estimated-occupancy`, keyed by buildingId, after every accepted tick with at least one router answering. Consumed by telemetry (Rust), which stores each room as an `estimatedOccupancy` reading. Never feeds `totalDeviceCount`, which counts each phone in its loudest router's room.

rules.tick: The collector snapshot the devices were placed from, Unix milliseconds; becomes each reading's timestamp.
rules.rooms: Room id to connected devices placed in it. Every room on a floor with a placed router, zeros included; a room on a floor with none is left out, since twin cannot place anyone there.
rules.privacy: Counts only: no positions, tokens or ids.

cases.name: no room covered by a placed router

rejected.reason: a count of devices is never below zero
